methodological_eligibility.evidence_quote: This paper has provided an overview of how federal energy policy is structured and supported through Presidential Executive Orders, and efficiently managed using an EnMSubsystem within a facility’s EMS.

stage1.ineligibility_reason: The paper presents an EnMS/EMS integration framework and policy case study without identifying or characterising an EnPI or EnB measurement model.

paper_type.evidence_quote: the authors use Naval Hospital Beaufort (NHB), as a case study to demonstrate the use of an EMS to integrate an energy management system

stage1.notes: Policy and management-system integration case; no EnPI/EnB measurement-model content is characterised.
